arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Virginia claims the statute protects freedom from fear. It bans only cross-burning used to threaten harm. It does not ban all cross-burning. It avoids playing favorites unlike prior cases.

Black claims targeting a specific symbol violates the First Amendment. It engages in content and viewpoint discrimination. The state should use content-neutral alternatives. Courts should err on the side of speech freedom.
Virginia argues cross-burning is a particularly threatening form of conduct. The state singled it out with intent to intimidate. This distinguishes it from general speech protections.
